title: Aritmetris - Math that goes down easy
author: hunteel
selftext:
I published this game several months ago, and until now I hadn't made a trailer for it. Well, now it's here.

It's a simple trailer, but I think it shows pretty well what the game is about. After watching it, I think you'll know whether this game appeals to you or not.

If you like falling-block puzzle games, I think you might find it fun. Well, you need to like maths a little bit too, but...

It's available in English, Spanish, Catalan, Basque and Galician.

You can play it here:  
[https://game.aritmetris.com](https://game.aritmetris.com/)

Or on itch.io:  
[https://morrins.itch.io/aritmetris](https://morrins.itch.io/aritmetris)

If you're interested in the origins of the project, and how it was brought back from an unpublished Flash version I made in 2010 into what it is today, you can read about it here:  
[https://www.aritmetris.com/en/postmortem.html](https://www.aritmetris.com/en/postmortem.html)

Hope you like it.

I'm now developing a new game, totally different from this one, and I'm eager to show it. But it's not finished yet. It still needs a lot of polish before I'm ready to put it out there — especially because I'm writing a story mode and I want to write all of it myself, so that part needs more time.
